summary.intent: Determine whether phase 73 (CipherBox) had unresolved discussion points before planning, then kick off `/gsd-plan-phase 73` on the correct branch while folding in any tangential pending todos into scope.
summary.outcome: Confirmed no blocking discussion artifacts existed for phase 73; identified one genuine open fork in the WRITE-03 todo (SC4) and recommended proceeding with 'wire it end-to-end'. Folded two tangential todos into ROADMAP.md with new success criteria, created the correctly-named branch `feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web`, and committed the ROADMAP scoping changes on it before planning starts.

repo: GSD's `phase_branch_template` is "feat/{slug}" where slug is the phase directory name minus the number prefix — e.g. phase 72 used `feat/sdk-write-plane-durability-and-correctness`.
The gsd-planner tool sometimes spins up a stray `docs/plan-phase-N` branch instead of respecting the configured `feat/{slug}` template, requiring manual correction.

ROADMAP.md phase entries map named success criteria 1:1 to named source todos, making scope changes traceable — folding a todo in requires both listing it and adding a corresponding success criterion.

The WRITE-03 todo (2026-07-02-write03-refresh-access-path-has-no-live-trigger.md) for `refreshWriteAccess`/`CannotWriteUntilRefetchError` describes an architectural fork (wire end-to-end vs. trim the unreachable branch), not a settled spec — SC4 in phase 73 requires resolving this.
workflow: When needing to classify a large number of pending items (51 todos) against a scope, delegate the classification to a subagent rather than reading each file directly to preserve context budget.

Commit scoping edits (e.g. ROADMAP.md changes) on the target feature branch before invoking a planner known to sometimes create its own branch, so the correct branch already carries the anchored state and any stray branch can be reconciled afterward.

friction: No phase-73 directory or discuss-phase artifacts existed yet, requiring manual cross-checking of ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, and individual todo files to confirm readiness for planning.

gsd-planner's tendency to create a mismatched default branch (`docs/plan-phase-73`) rather than the configured `feat/{slug}` template required proactive branch creation and a plan to reconcile if it recurs.
open_items: SC4 fork in WRITE-03 (wire `refreshWriteAccess` end-to-end with real API tombstone + rotation-ux e2e upgrade, vs. trim the dead classifier path) — recommended 'wire it end-to-end' but not yet confirmed/decided by the user.
STATE.md Q1 (Phase 68) remains open: whether co-writer-offline-during-write-key-rotation should require explicit re-fetch or use grace/notification — tied to the SC4 decision.
Three adjacent-but-separate todos (SDK merge parity, dead SDK scaffolding retirement, ESLint boundary rule) were deliberately excluded from phase 73 scope; revisit if they become relevant.

Need to verify after running `/gsd-plan-phase 73` whether the planner still spins up a stray `docs/plan-phase-73` branch despite already being on `feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web`, and reconcile if so.
